lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters (spots) distributed across the lateral flank, displaying a semi-regular grid arrangement with higher local density in the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like matrix of anchor nodes across the central visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear horizontal features on the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent caustic network patterns caused by surface light refraction are overlaid across the entire visible mid-section and the distal portion of the pectoral fin.
